title: Target Search Optimization by Threshold Resetting
abstract: arXiv:2504.13501v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce a new class of first-passage time optimization driven by threshold resetting, inspired by many natural processes where crossing a critical limit triggers failure, degradation, or transition. Here, search agents are collectively reset when a threshold is reached, creating event-driven, system-coupled simultaneous resets that induce long-range interactions. We develop a unified framework to compute mean search times for these correlated stochastic processes, with ballistic and diffusive searchers as key examples uncovering diverse optimization behaviors. A cost function, akin to breakdown penalties, reveals that optimal resetting can forestall larger losses. This formalism generalizes to broader stochastic systems with multiple degrees of freedom.

translated_title: 基于阈值重置的目标搜索优化
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一类由阈值重置驱动的首次通过时间优化新问题，其灵感来源于许多自然过程——在这些过程中，超过临界限度会触发失败、退化或转变。在该框架中，当达到某个阈值时，搜索智能体会被集体重置，从而产生事件驱动、系统耦合的同步重置，引发长程相互作用。我们开发了一个统一框架来计算这些相关随机过程的平均搜索时间，并以弹道式和扩散式搜索者作为关键例子，揭示了多样化的优化行为。一个类似于故障惩罚的成本函数表明，最优重置策略可以避免更大的损失。这一形式化方法可推广到具有多自由度的更广泛的随机系统。
tldr: 本文提出了一类由阈值重置驱动的首次通过时间优化新框架，通过事件驱动、系统耦合的同步重置机制建立了计算相关随机过程平均搜索时间的统一方法，并证明最优重置策略能够避免更大的损失。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a new class of first-passage time optimization driven by threshold resetting, developing a unified framework to compute mean search times for correlated stochastic processes with event-driven, system-coupled simultaneous resets, and demonstrating that optimal resetting can forestall larger losses.
